title: Recording, mixing: Looking Over From My Hotel Window, Death Of Samantha by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

A recording and mixing session for Yoko Ono‘s third album Approximately Infinite Universe took place on 25 November 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

The new song was ‘Looking Over From My Hotel Window’. More recording for the song took place on 26 November, and it was mixed on the 27th and 28th.

The other song worked on during this session was ‘Death Of Samantha’, which had been recorded on 15 November. It was first mixed on 19 November, but the final version was created on this day.
